messages:
nicole.support: FYI — Orchard Labs reporting a sudden wave of 502/504s hitting our hosted /v1/generate endpoint (mostly in us-west-2). Customer says it started ~10:20 PDT and is ongoing. Error rate ~8-12% for their traffic.
nicole.support: Repro steps from their SDK (node):
```js
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', input: 'hello' });
// they see 504 after ~2s sometimes, otherwise 502
```
nicole.support: Sample curl and one request-id from logs: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate`
log excerpt: `request_id=or123f time=2026-03-15T17:23:12Z status=504 route=/v1/generate gateway="edge-proxy-7"`
sam-oncall: Definitely needs tracing info + request_ids for failed calls. Can you paste a few distinct request_ids and timestamps so SRE can grep?
nicole.support: Pasted 3 ids: or123f, or1240, or1249 (all from us-west-2). Also attaching the customer's short HAR in the ticket (link redacted). They say retries happen in client -> duplicate failures and then a big spike in token billing which they noticed.
jia-eng: From quick look — repeated 502/504s from edge-proxy-7 -> upstreams returning 502. Could be connection termination or keepalive mismatch between edge and gateway pools. Any recent kernel/network or deploys around 17:20 UTC? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: deploy: service/gateway v2.18.3 rolled to us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T17:18:50Z by jia-eng
mike-sre: Thanks. Rollout window aligns. Can you share gateway logs for the request_ids? Also check socket errors like ECONNRESET / TLS alerts. If gateway started closing idle connections aggressively after the deploy, that might explain the wave.
nicole.support: Pasted truncated gateway log for or123f:
```
[17:23:12.345] request_id=or123f client_ip=35.2.1.5 status=504 upstream_latency_ms=2000 upstream_error="connection reset by peer"
[17:23:12.346] request_id=or123f route=/v1/generate backend=worker-45 state=cancelled
```
ashley-cs: Customer impact: Orchard Labs has 3 customer-facing services degraded; they want ETA and mitigation. They will escalate to their SLT if >1hr. Please keep comms tight.
sam-oncall: Short mitigation: add an emergency routing rule to send Orchard traffic to us-west-2-b fallback pool (older stable gateway) while we investigate. Jia, can we hot-route? jia-eng: Yes, we can add a routing override for their org id for 15m to fallback pool.
orin-devex: Quick note — SDK v1.4.2 had a bug where it aggressively reopens streams on partial failures leading to thundering retries. v1.4.3 was released with a backoff fix; can customer try v1.4.3 as a low-friction mitigation while we triage? Include env var `REDWOOD_SDK_BACKOFF=enabled`.
mike-sre: We'll also revert the small keepalive tuning from v2.18.3 if traffic still fails after routing change. Rolling that check now.
deploy-bot: rollback-candidate: service/gateway v2.18.2 available. Initiating canary rollback in us-west-2 at 17:35:10Z
jia-eng: Observed metrics: connection error spikes in gateway outbound pool at 17:19-17:25 UTC. Packet captures show TLS renegotiation from the gateway to worker hosts. Possible client cert expiry? Need to validate cert rotations on worker fleet.
nicole.support: Orchard provided a pcap showing resets immediately after TLS handshake. Customer also said they rotated their KMS token at 16:50 but that should not affect our internal worker certs.
mike-sre: Confirmed worker TLS cert rotation completed at 16:47 — logs show cert reloads on worker-42..worker-48. There is a mismatch in cipher preference between new worker builds and gateway which triggers renegotiation; gateway then closes connection mid-request -> 502/504.
jia-eng: Patch queued to align cipher suites; will push to us-west-2 fallback pool first for verification. ETA 45m.
ashley-cs: Communicated to customer: "We've put a temporary routing override and recommended SDK 1.4.3 with backoff. Our engineering teams are applying a targeted fix. We'll update in 30m." Customer acknowledged and asked for link to incident thread.
nicole.support: Routing override applied at 17:38 UTC. Orchard reports error rate dropped to ~0.5% within 5m. They switched to SDK 1.4.3 and no longer see retry storms.
orin-devex: Patch to cipher suites verified in staging, will promote to fallback pool in 20m.
mike-sre: After routing + rollback, errors dropped cluster-wide. We'll keep routing override for 1h then switch traffic back gradually with canary checks. Schedule postmortem once patch fully rolled.
ashley-cs: Customer happy with workaround and wants a short write-up and SLA credit request template ready if incident duration >2h. Nicole, can you own customer follow-up?
nicole.support: Will own comms and link to postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
sam-oncall: Adding tags: incident.type=5xx_wave, root_cause=suite_mismatch_tls_reneg, mitigation=route_override+sdk_backoff+rollback
jia-eng: Opening a ticket for long-term fix to standardize cipher suites across worker and gateway images.
mike-sre: I'll keep monitoring for next 2 hours and will hand off to oncall rotation after that.
orioops: (bot notification) Reminder: create postmortem doc in /incident-postmortems within 24h."
